ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three JK flip-flops, corresponding respectively to outputs Q0, Q1, Q2 from right to left; the C terminals of the three flip-flops are all connected to the same CP clock line at the bottom, so it is synchronous triggering. The output line of the right-side Q0 flip-flop is labeled upward as Q0 and is fed back to the input logic of the middle Q1 flip-flop; the signals of the middle Q1 and the right-side Q0 are sent into the AND gate near the left side, and the AND gate output is then sent to the J-terminal logic of the left-side Q2 flip-flop; at the same time, it can be seen that the Q2-related feedback line goes around to the right side, used to limit the Q0 stage from continuing normal counting when Q2 is 1. From the connections in the figure, the equivalent result is obtained: the Q0 stage toggles when Q2=0, and is inhibited/cleared when Q2=1; the Q1 stage is controlled by Q0 feedback to toggle; the Q2 stage is controlled to set by the AND signal of Q1 and Q0, and resets on the next clock. Reasoning: Starting from the initial state Q2Q1Q0=000, analyze clock by clock according to the JK flip-flop state transitions. At 000, Q0 toggles to 1, Q1 and Q2 remain, obtaining 001. At 001, Q0 toggles from 1 to 0, Q1 toggles from 0 to 1, Q2 remains 0, obtaining 010. At 010, Q0 toggles from 0 to 1, Q1 remains 1, Q2 remains 0, obtaining 011. At 011, Q0 toggles from 1 to 0, Q1 toggles from 1 to 0, and at the same time Q1Q0=11 causes Q2 to set to 1, obtaining 100. At 100, the Q2 feedback causes the circuit to return to 000. The reachable cycle sequence is: 000 -> 001 -> 010 -> 011 -> 100 -> 000, with a total of 5 different states before returning to the initial state, therefore this synchronous up counter is a modulo-5 counter.

Convert those wires into effective JK excitations, then starting from Q2Q1Q0 = 000 apply the JK next-state table on each clock edge. method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有三个JK触发器，按从右到左分别对应输出Q0、Q1、Q2；三个触发器的C端都接到底部同一条CP时钟线，所以是同步触发。右侧Q0触发器的输出线向上标为Q0，并反馈到中间Q1触发器的输入逻辑；中间Q1和右侧Q0的信号送入左侧附近的与门，与门输出再送到左侧Q2触发器的J端逻辑；同时可以看到Q2相关反馈线绕到右侧，用于限制Q0级在Q2为1时继续正常计数。由图中连线等效得到：Q0级在Q2=0时翻转、在Q2=1时被抑制/清零；Q1级由Q0反馈控制翻转；Q2级由Q1和Q0的与信号控制置位，并在下一拍复位。推理：从初态Q2Q1Q0=000开始，按JK触发器状态转换逐拍分析。000时，Q0翻转为1，Q1、Q2保持，得到001。001时，Q0由1翻转为0，Q1由0翻转为1，Q2保持0，得到010。010时，Q0由0翻转为1，Q1保持1，Q2保持0，得到011。011时，Q0由1翻转为0，Q1由1翻转为0，同时Q1Q0=11使Q2置1，得到100。100时，Q2反馈使电路回到000。可达循环序列为：000 -> 001 -> 010 -> 011 -> 100 -> 000，共有5个不同状态后回到初态，因此该同步加法计数器为模5计数器。
